headline: Draft FY28 bike and pedestrian capital improvement plan and a VTrans transportation alternatives grant application.
summary: The plan and grant application are the main topics. A Safe Routes to School conference review and updates from three sub-groups are also on the list.
items: VTrans Transportation Alternatives grant application discussion
Draft Bike/Ped Capital Improvement Plan review
Safe Routes to School conference review and presentation
Sub-group updates: DRB, Safety, Communications and Outreach
location: 180 Market Street, 2nd Floor, Library Conference Room, also online via Zoom
